title: AWS DMS Full-Load + CDC Replication Setup
description: Configure AWS Database Migration Service for full-load followed by CDC (Change Data Capture) replication.

steps.action: Create DMS Replication Instance (dms.r6i.large or larger) in same VPC as source/target
steps.verify: Replication instance status = Available in DMS console

steps.action: Create Source Endpoint: Oracle with connection string, supplemental logging enabled (ALTER DATABASE ADD SUPPLEMENTAL LOG DATA)
steps.verify: Test Connection = Successful in DMS endpoint console

steps.action: Create Target Endpoint: Aurora PostgreSQL with credentials and database name
steps.verify: Test Connection = Successful; target schema exists from SCT conversion

steps.action: Create Migration Task: Full load + CDC, LOB settings = Limited LOB mode, Max LOB size = 32KB
steps.verify: Task status = Ready; table mappings show all source tables included

steps.action: Start task: Full load phase — monitor Table Statistics for row counts
steps.verify: All tables Load State = Table completed; source and target row counts match within 0.01%
steps.rollback: Stop task, truncate Aurora tables, restart

steps.action: Verify CDC is running: CDC latency in DMS metrics < 5 seconds
steps.verify: CloudWatch DMS CDCLatencySource < 5s and CDCLatencyTarget < 5s for 30 minutes
